title: Mets' Jefry Yan, known for high-flying strikeout celebration, performs it too soon in hilarious blunder
summary: Mets reliever Jefry Yan thought he had strike three against the Nationals, but as he jumped in the air to perform his signature celebration, he realized the umpire didn't call it.

title: Michael Penix Jr and Tua Tagovailoa have already given us a potential 'Meme of the Year' contender
summary: Michael Penix Jr.'s bewildered sideline reaction pointing at Tua Tagovailoa during the Falcons' preseason opener is already going viral as a meme.

title: Alaska runner hospitalized after using bear spray to fight off brown bear on Alaska trail
summary: A runner on Anchorage's Wolverine Bowl trail used bear spray to fend off a brown bear and was hospitalized, marking the second attack in the area in weeks.

title: Nevada man funneled 140 guns to violent Mexican drug cartels, including powerful 'military-style' rifles: DOJ
summary: Luis Alberto Osorio admitted to buying 140 firearms including military-style rifles for violent Mexican drug-trafficking organizations in a straw purchase scheme.

title: Jessica Simpson turns heads in bikini photos from trip to Turks and Caicos
summary: Jessica Simpson shared bikini photos from her Turks and Caicos birthday trip on Instagram, lounging in a black polka dot two-piece in paradise.

title: Bills' Dion Dawkins sparks intense debate after picking up his dog's poop on practice field
summary: Video shows Buffalo Bills offensive tackle Dion Dawkins scooping dog poop off the NFL practice field in Crocs, igniting a fierce online debate.

title: Deshaun Watson's first game since 2024 a success because he wasn't as bad as Shedeur Sanders or Dillon Gabriel
summary: Deshaun Watson completed 11 of 15 passes in his return from dual Achilles tears, while Shedeur Sanders and Dillon Gabriel both threw interceptions.

title: Vikings fear worst as Jamal Adams, former All-Pro safety, suffers knee injury in preseason game: 'Not good'
summary: Jamal Adams was carted off at MetLife Stadium with a knee injury, and Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said the first look was "not good" for the veteran.

title: Jaxson Dart gets last laugh against blitzing Vikings coach Brian Flores and the ominous blue medical tent
summary: Jaxson Dart was rocked by a Jay Ward blitz in the Giants-Vikings preseason opener, causing another medical evaluation for a concussion and questions about his return to play.

title: Henry Winkler opens up about the unexpected career he considered before becoming an actor
summary: Henry Winkler almost studied to become a child psychologist before transitioning into a career as an actor and finding fame as Fonzie on "Happy Days."
